summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, in the accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (like native defaultChecked).

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit (valueMissing). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor disables it too without changing this attribute.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x18 track with a 16px thumb, sm 24x14 track with a 12px thumb. The label text does not change.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the control in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: a pill holding the native input (visually covering the track) and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, aria-hidden; at the start while off, at the end while on (mirrored in RTL).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in a listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end; on and off differ by position as well as color (WCAG 1.4.1). The slide and color transition use switch.transition-*, and are removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. formValue(): value only while checked, else null. formReset(): checked back to the checked attribute. formStateRestore(): restores checked from the saved state. validationAnchor(): the inner input, so required -> valueMissing and reportValidity() focuses it. Inner input renders ?disabled=${isDisabled}; a disabled fieldset disables it without touching the attribute; disabled is not submitted. syncFormState() runs in the input handler so change listeners see the new FormData. A <label for> click on the host is forwarded to the input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track 32x18 (sm 24x14); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty (NativeControl).

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). It does not toggle: APG makes Enter optional and the native checkbox does not toggle on Enter.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; checked state exposed natively as aria-checked true/false
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
thumb is aria-hidden; the label never changes with the state (no On/Off text swap)
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect as soon as it changes
The same on/off setting is saved with a form
useCases.use: sb-switch with name (submits value while on)

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for choosing several options from a list, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: Those record a choice rather than turn a setting on; the WAI-ARIA APG and the visual reference present them as checkboxes

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The APG switch pattern keeps the label constant; the state is conveyed by aria-checked, so a changing label is read twice or contradicts it
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch that toggles a pressed button state in a toolbar
antiPatterns.why: That is a toggle button (aria-pressed), not a setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn bg-input is neutral-200 (dark: white 15% at 80%), below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
shadcn uses foreground in dark mode; background keeps 3:1 on the 3:1 track in both modes
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference Switch (look, sizes default and sm) and the WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern; label row beside the track like Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch> like the visual reference?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: native checkbox with role=switch. It reuses FormAssociated + NativeControl (rule form-associated-controls), gets Space, required/valueMissing, label activation and :disabled from the platform (SB-0007: native first). Taken without a reviewer per SB-0011.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. Enter submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009), like Checkbox and the native checkbox; APG lists Enter as optional for switches. Taken per SB-0011.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (native defaultChecked), as in Checkbox. Taken per SB-0011.

openQuestions.question: Does size=sm also shrink the label text?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. The visual reference's size only changes the track and thumb; the label keeps the control font size so a settings list stays readable. Taken per SB-0011.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, given the visual reference names a Switch with an external Label?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: yes, like Checkbox and Input; external <label for> cannot name a control in shadow DOM. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name. Taken per SB-0011.

openQuestions.question: Track width: a new semantic size token, or derived from the thumb?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: derived. Width = 2 x thumb size, height = thumb size + 2 x track inset, thumb travel = width - thumb - 2 x inset; this gives 32x18 / 24x14 from existing tokens, and the two sizes stay proportional. No new semantic token. Taken per SB-0011.
